sources.title: OpenTelemetry specification overview
sources.usage_limits: Use for OpenTelemetry signal, context, collection, and interoperability semantics; reverify version-sensitive SDK behavior.
sources.notes: Primary project specification used by the production-engineering lesson family.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry logging specification
sources.usage_limits: Use for the logging signal and data-model boundary; avoid implying every backend implements the specification identically.
sources.notes: Primary project specification.

sources.title: Service Level Objectives
sources.usage_limits: Use as first-party operating guidance, not as a universal contractual SLA policy.
sources.notes: Supports user-centered SLI and SLO decision framing.

sources.title: Alerting on SLOs
sources.usage_limits: Use for burn-rate and SLO-alerting reasoning; examples require adaptation to the system's actual window and traffic.
sources.notes: Supports symptom-led paging and budget-consumption examples.

sources.title: RFC 6749: The OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework
sources.usage_limits: Read with current OAuth security best-current-practice guidance; do not present obsolete grant recommendations as current advice.
sources.notes: Protocol-role source for OAuth delegation.

sources.title: RFC 6750: OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token Usage
sources.usage_limits: Use for bearer-token semantics and threats; application authorization and revocation policy remain separate design work.
sources.notes: Protocol source for possession-based bearer authority.

sources.title: RFC 7519: JSON Web Token
sources.usage_limits: Use for JWT structure and registered claims; pair with RFC 8725 for current security guidance.
sources.notes: Claims-format source.

sources.title: RFC 7636: Proof Key for Code Exchange
sources.usage_limits: Use for authorization-code interception protection; it does not replace redirect, state, issuer, client, or token validation.
sources.notes: Protocol source for PKCE.

sources.title: RFC 8725: JSON Web Token Best Current Practices
sources.usage_limits: Use for JWT validation threats and mutually exclusive validation rules; deployment policy must still name issuer, audience, purpose, and keys.
sources.notes: Current JWT best-current-practice source.

sources.title: RFC 9846: The Transport Layer Security Protocol Version 1.3
sources.usage_limits: Use for current TLS 1.3 protocol behavior; application identity, authorization, storage encryption, and post-termination plaintext remain separate boundaries.
sources.notes: Obsoletes RFC 8446 and anchors the current TLS lesson.

sources.title: OpenID Connect Core 1.0 incorporating errata set 2
sources.usage_limits: Use for the OIDC identity layer and ID-token validation; do not conflate ID tokens with access tokens.
sources.notes: Current errata-integrated core specification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-207A: A Zero Trust Architecture Model for Access Control in Cloud-Native Applications
sources.usage_limits: Use for resource-centric access-control architecture, not as a product certification or a substitute for application threat modeling.
sources.notes: Authoritative government architecture guidance.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5: Recommendation for Key Management
sources.usage_limits: Use for key-management lifecycle principles; algorithm selection and compliance requirements need current system-specific review.
sources.notes: Authoritative key-management guidance.

sources.title: Authorization Cheat Sheet
sources.usage_limits: Use as defensive architecture guidance; concrete policy must be derived from the application's resources and actions.
sources.notes: Application authorization guidance.

sources.title: Multi-Tenant Security Cheat Sheet
sources.usage_limits: Use for tenant-isolation design prompts; actual isolation guarantees require system-specific negative tests and operational controls.
sources.notes: End-to-end multi-tenant boundary guidance.

sources.title: Session Management Cheat Sheet
sources.usage_limits: Use for session lifecycle and browser threat guidance; framework and provider behavior must be verified separately.
sources.notes: Application session guidance.

sources.title: Secrets Management Cheat Sheet
sources.usage_limits: Use for secret lifecycle and operational controls; product-specific vault and rotation behavior requires current provider verification.
sources.notes: Secrets lifecycle guidance.

sources.title: OWASP API Security Top 10 — 2023
sources.usage_limits: Use for API threat categories and architecture prompts, not as evidence that a specific implementation is secure.
sources.notes: Current OWASP API risk taxonomy at review time.

sources.title: Denial of Service Cheat Sheet
sources.usage_limits: Use for layered denial-of-service mitigation; capacity, fail-open behavior, and provider controls require system-specific verification.
sources.notes: Resource-exhaustion guidance.

sources.title: PostgreSQL warm standby and replication
sources.usage_limits: Use for replication and standby-read mechanics; application freshness and failover policy remain design-specific.
sources.notes: Supports the read-replica freshness boundary.

sources.title: Caching challenges and strategies
sources.usage_limits: Use for cache failure and operating trade-offs, not as a universal provider configuration.
sources.notes: Supports read-heavy miss-path and stampede reasoning.

sources.title: Designing partition keys to distribute workloads
sources.usage_limits: Use for partition-key distribution concepts; current service quotas require provider verification.
sources.notes: Supports hot-partition diagnosis.

sources.title: Using write sharding to distribute workloads evenly
sources.usage_limits: Use for random and calculated write-sharding trade-offs, not for universal shard-count guidance.
sources.notes: Supports write scaling and hot-key mitigation.

sources.title: Overview of the Pub/Sub service
sources.usage_limits: Use for fan-out versus load-balanced subscription semantics; verify product limits and delivery options separately.
sources.notes: Supports independent subscription and competing-consumer distinctions.

sources.title: Best practices for background jobs
sources.usage_limits: Use for durable background-work decisions; concrete worker and queue guarantees remain platform-specific.
sources.notes: Supports job status, retry, and result patterns.

sources.title: Asynchronous Request-Reply pattern
sources.usage_limits: Use for accepted-operation and status-resource semantics, not as a requirement to poll when push is appropriate.
sources.notes: Supports long-running job product truth.

sources.title: Dataflow overview
sources.usage_limits: Use for bounded and unbounded processing concepts; service modes, cost, and delivery guarantees require current verification.
sources.notes: Supports a shared programming model with distinct batch and streaming operations.

sources.title: CQRS pattern
sources.usage_limits: Use for command/query model separation and eventual-consistency trade-offs, not as a default service template.
sources.notes: Supports the complexity threshold and projection boundary.

sources.title: PostgreSQL explicit locking
sources.usage_limits: Use for lock and deadlock mechanics; business conflict policy and retry limits remain application decisions.
sources.notes: Supports lock-order and bounded-transaction guidance.

sources.title: Saga distributed transactions pattern
sources.usage_limits: Use for local transactions and compensating actions; compensation does not guarantee restoration of every external effect.
sources.notes: Supports durable multi-step workflow reasoning.

sources.title: Uploading and copying objects using multipart upload
sources.usage_limits: Use for multipart transfer, checksums, completion, and cleanup concepts; verify current object-store limits separately.
sources.notes: Supports resumable large-file transfer and explicit completion.

sources.title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
sources.usage_limits: Use for PostgreSQL isolation semantics; do not generalize implementation details to every database.
sources.notes: Supports transaction-conflict reasoning.

sources.title: Competing Consumers pattern
sources.usage_limits: Use for shared-queue consumer semantics; delivery and ordering guarantees depend on the selected broker.
sources.notes: Distinguishes competing workers from independent subscriber copies.

sources.title: Plan your Dataflow pipeline
sources.usage_limits: Use for pipeline-planning boundaries; tune windows, replay, and resource choices to the actual workload.
sources.notes: Supports event-time and recovery framing.

sources.title: Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
sources.usage_limits: Use for retry identity and idempotency guidance; operation-specific conflict and retention policy still require design.
sources.notes: Supports replay-safe workflow-step reasoning.

sources.title: High-level view of AWS Database Migration Service
sources.usage_limits: Use for migration topology and staged data movement; application compatibility and rollback remain explicit design work.
sources.notes: Primary platform documentation for the schema and data migration lesson.

sources.title: Incident Management Guide
sources.usage_limits: Use for incident roles and lifecycle guidance; severity and communication policy must match the operating organization.
sources.notes: Primary operating-practice source for incident recovery.

sources.title: Threat Modeling Cheat Sheet
sources.usage_limits: Use for threat-model structure and review practices; it is not a substitute for system-specific security analysis.
sources.notes: Primary community security guidance for the threat-modeling lesson.

sources.title: Manage demand and supply resources
sources.usage_limits: Use for demand, supply, and utilization framing; pricing and service-specific limits require current verification.
sources.notes: Primary platform guidance for the cost and efficiency lesson.

sources.title: Evolving the SRE Engagement Model
sources.usage_limits: Use for service engagement and ownership boundaries; team structure and decision rights remain organization-specific.
sources.notes: Primary operating-practice source for operational ownership.

sources.title: Creating tasks for ongoing replication
sources.usage_limits: Use for snapshot-plus-change replication concepts; ordering and consistency guarantees depend on the chosen source and target.
sources.notes: Primary platform documentation for live-change-aware rebuilds.

sources.title: Kubernetes cluster architecture
sources.usage_limits: Use as one concrete control-plane/data-plane architecture; the lesson's separation principle is vendor-neutral.
sources.notes: Primary project documentation for the plane-boundary lesson.

sources.title: Reporting and reconciliation
sources.usage_limits: Use for provider reconciliation concepts; accounting treatment and legal obligations require qualified review.
sources.notes: Primary payment-provider documentation for the payment and ledger lesson.

sources.title: HDFS Architecture
sources.usage_limits: Use for namespace, block, replication, and recovery concepts; implementation-specific defaults require current verification.
sources.notes: Primary project documentation for the distributed file systems lesson.

sources.title: Amazon Redshift managed storage considerations
sources.usage_limits: Use as one implementation example of disaggregated storage and compute; pricing and performance remain service-specific.
sources.notes: Primary platform documentation for the storage and compute separation lesson.

sources.title: AWS DMS data validation
sources.usage_limits: Use for source-target validation concepts; validation coverage and resource cost remain design-specific.
sources.notes: Supports parity gates for migrations and rebuilds.

sources.title: Postmortem Culture: Learning from Failure
sources.usage_limits: Use for blameless learning and action ownership; do not treat one organization's process as universal policy.
sources.notes: Supports evidence-led postmortem practice.

sources.title: Continuous Archiving and Point-in-Time Recovery
sources.usage_limits: Use for PostgreSQL recovery mechanics; recovery objectives, restore testing, and retained history require deployment-specific policy.
sources.notes: Supports data-recovery verification examples.

sources.title: Idempotent requests
sources.usage_limits: Use for request retry identity; idempotency does not replace ledger invariants or reconciliation.
sources.notes: Supports ambiguous payment-attempt recovery.

sources.title: How disputes work
sources.usage_limits: Use for dispute lifecycle examples; legal, scheme, and provider obligations require current specialist verification.
sources.notes: Supports disputes as a separate long-running economic outcome.
